# Non-device note

An ERROR is final on Junos ([the note](https://github.com/blanketfish/port49/blob/main/tests/lab/results/L4-error-juniper_vsrx.md)).

An ERROR is final on Junos again ([L4](https://github.com/blanketfish/port49/blob/main/tests/lab/results/L4-error-juniper_vsrx.md)).

A note for no device needs no platform word ([the host note](https://github.com/blanketfish/port49/blob/main/tests/lab/results/L92-ser8.md)).

!!! warning "Unmeasured"
    Whether this holds elsewhere is not measured. The closed row's note is
    [here](https://github.com/blanketfish/port49/blob/main/tests/lab/results/L45-juniper_vsrx.md).
